description: This file implements a C++ class for managing container lifecycle operations using the runc tool, including creating, executing commands, deleting, and retrieving state information of containers. It defines classes for container configuration, state information, and a runner to interface with the runc executable, along with container administrator and container classes that manage individual container instances.

classes.name: Runner
classes.description: Encapsulates operations to create, execute, delete, and query the state of containers via the runc command-line tool. Contains nested classes for container configuration, process data, and container state info.

classes.name: Runner::Info
classes.description: Holds container process ID and status information, serializable to/from JSON.

classes.name: Runner::Config
classes.description: Represents container configuration, including environment variables for the process inside the container.

classes.name: Runner::Config::ProcessData
classes.description: Holds environment variable list for container process configuration.

classes.name: RunCContainer
classes.description: Represents a container instance managed via runc, providing methods to start, stop, and query container status, as well as retrieve resource usage metrics.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new container with specified ID and bundle path using runc.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the container, optionally with parameters.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the container, with optional timeout.

methods.name: State
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the container, populating an Info object.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists all containers in quiet mode.

methods.name: InheritHostEnvironmentVariables
methods.description: Reads environment variables from the container's config.json and propagates them to the runc command options.
